---
### Play Store Version

The Play Store variant (`mpvEx-playstore-v1.2.9.apk`) is specifically built for Google Play Store:
- Universal APK supporting all architectures (arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86, x86_64)
- Removed automatic update feature (handled by Play Store)
- Minimal permissions for maximum compatibility

---
### F-Droid Version

The F-Droid variant (`mpvEx-fdroid-v1.2.9.apk`) is specifically built for F-Droid compatibility:
- Removed automatic update feature
- Removed install packages permission
- ARM64-v8a architecture only

## What's Changed
* Updated Screenshots 1.2.8 by @7lilnewbie in https://github.com/marlboro-advance/mpvEx/pull/607
* feat: implement True Ambient Mode with Shader by @Riteshp2001 in https://github.com/marlboro-advance/mpvEx/pull/619
* Hero image on website by @7lilnewbie in https://github.com/marlboro-advance/mpvEx/pull/623
* Refactor TrackSelector for performance improvements and BugFix by @Chinna95P in https://github.com/marlboro-advance/mpvEx/pull/647
* Add Ambient-Mode link to README by @Chinna95P in https://github.com/marlboro-advance/mpvEx/pull/640
* feat: add Ambient Mode functionality and enhance subtitle search by @marlboro-advance in https://github.com/marlboro-advance/mpvEx/pull/658
* feat: autoscroll to currently selected theme by @Arnab11 in https://github.com/marlboro-advance/mpvEx/pull/660
* Enhance player functionality with ambient mode improvements and fixes by @marlboro-advance in https://github.com/marlboro-advance/mpvEx/pull/671
